headline: Binghamton's defense allows nine goals all season
dek: Binghamton finished top of the conference table, its lone loss to a member coming at Vermont. Its season ended at nine wins, six draws and three losses, and its 29 goals stand level with UMBC's.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: New Hampshire outscored every side but Binghamton and UMBC, yet lost eight matches and conceded 30.

wire.line: UMBC's Amara Codd ends the season with eight shutouts in goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UMass Lowell's home match with Siena in August is past its date and still carries no result, the only such match in the conference.

findings.label: derived
